an5.206:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāmesu avigatarāgo hoti, avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
an5.206:1.4: yo so bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāmesu avigatarāgo hoti, avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an5.206:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye avigatarāgo hoti, …pe… [ayaṃ dutiyo cetaso vinibandho] …pe…
an5.206:2.2: rūpe avigatarāgo hoti …pe… [ayaṃ tatiyo cetaso vinibandho] …pe…
an5.206:2.3: yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati …pe… [ayaṃ catuttho cetaso vinibandho] …pe…
an5.206:2.4: aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati: ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti.
an5.206:2.5: yo so bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati : ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapenavā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti. tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an5.206:2.6: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṃ pañcamo cetaso vinibandho.
